Flower and pod counts of faba bean plants

Source: R/data.R
FabaCounts23.Rd

Repeated counts of flowers and pods of 22 faba bean plants of six genotypes, all with the treatment "ww", on twelve days between 61 and 79 days after sowing (2023).

Usage

FabaCounts23

Format

A data frame with 263 rows and 9 variables:

Tube_ID

identifier of the tube of the plant

Genotype

genotype: Aurora, Capri, ILB938, Lynx, Melodie or Navara

Treatment

treatment, "ww" for all plants

DAS

days after sowing

New

number of new flowers

Open

number of open flowers

Old

number of old flowers

Pods

number of pods

N_flowers

number of flowers, the sum of New, Open and Old

The raw data and the script that converts them are in the directory data-raw of the source package.

Examples

fit <- gcTMB(Pods ~ DAS, fform=b1 ~ Genotype, data=FabaCounts23, family="poisson")
summary(fit)
